```{r}
asdf <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/updated_seurat_obj.rds")

rna <- as.data.frame(rownames(asdf))
colnames(rna) <- "genes"
genes <- rna$genes
ig_genes <- c(grep("^IGJ", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^IGH",genes,v=T),
                grep("^IGK", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^IGL", genes, v=T))
tcr_genes <- c(grep("^TRA", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^TRB",genes,v=T),
                grep("^TRD", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^TRG", genes, v=T))
mito <- grep("^MT-", genes, v=T)
ribo <- c(grep("^RPL", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^RPS",genes,v=T))
cell.cycle <- c(cc.genes$s.genes, cc.genes$g2m.genes)
other <- c(grep("^MTMR", genes, v=T), grep("^MTND", genes, v=T),"NEAT1","TMSB4X", "TMSB10")
bad_genes = unique(c(ig_genes, tcr_genes, mito, ribo, cell.cycle, other))
features.remove <- list(ig_genes, tcr_genes, mito, ribo, cell.cycle, other)
```





```{r}
table(asdf$cloneType)

#malig <- subset(asdf, cloneType == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)")
table(asdf$new.clones)
malig <- subset(asdf, new.clones == "Malignant")
table(malig$orig.ident)

ss <- head(unique(malig$orig.ident), 30)
ss <- subset(malig, orig.ident %in% ss)
table(ss$orig.ident)

metadata <- ss@meta.data
sampled_cells <- metadata %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  sample_n(size = min(1000, n()), replace = FALSE) %>%
  pull(barcode)
ss <- subset(ss, barcode %in% sampled_cells)
table(ss$orig.ident)

#ss.split <- SplitObject(ss, split.by = "orig.ident")
ss.no.split <- list()
ss.no.split[[1]] <- ss
geneNMF.programs <- GeneNMF::multiNMF(ss.no.split, assay="RNA", slot="data", k=c(20:30), L1=c(0,0), scale = T, center = T, nfeatures = 3000, min.exp = .05, hvg.blocklist = tcr_genes)
geneNMF.metaprograms <- GeneNMF::getMetaPrograms(geneNMF.programs,
                                        max.genes=30,
                                        hclust.method="ward.D2", 
                                        min.confidence = 0.8, 
                                        nMP = 30, 
                                        specificity.weight = 1, weight.explained = 1,
                                        metric = "jaccard")

GeneNMF::plotMetaPrograms(geneNMF.metaprograms, jaccard.cutoff = c(0,0.8))

png("tmp.png", height = 1000, width = 1000)
GeneNMF::plotMetaPrograms(geneNMF.metaprograms, jaccard.cutoff = c(0,0.8))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
mp.genes <- geneNMF.metaprograms$metaprograms.genes
ss <- AddModuleScore_UCell(ss, features = mp.genes, assay="RNA", ncores=30, name = "", slot = "data")
matrix <- ss@meta.data[,names(mp.genes)]
dimred <- as.matrix(matrix)
colnames(dimred) <- paste0("MP_",seq(1, ncol(dimred)))
ss@reductions[["MPsignatures"]] <- new("DimReduc",
                                         cell.embeddings = dimred,
                                         assay.used = "RNA",
                                         key = "MP_",
                                         global = FALSE)
ss <- RunUMAP(ss, reduction="MPsignatures", dims=1:length(ss@reductions[["MPsignatures"]]),
               metric = "euclidean", reduction.name = "umap_MP")
```

## NMF analysis
```{r}
library(NMF)
asdf$celltype.malig <- asdf$celltype
table(asdf$celltype.malig)
asdf$celltype.malig <- as.character(asdf$celltype.malig)
asdf$celltype.malig[asdf$new.clones == "Malignant"] <- "Malignant"
asdf$celltype.malig[asdf$new.clones == "Non_malignant"] <- "Non_Malignant"
table(asdf$celltype.malig)
asdf <- subset(asdf, celltype.malig != "T_NK_Cells")

rna <- as.data.frame(rownames(asdf))
colnames(rna) <- "genes"
genes <- rna$genes
ig_genes <- c(grep("^IGJ", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^IGH",genes,v=T),
                grep("^IGK", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^IGL", genes, v=T))
tcr_genes <- c(grep("^TRA", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^TRB",genes,v=T),
                grep("^TRD", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^TRG", genes, v=T))
mito <- grep("^MT-", genes, v=T)
ribo <- c(grep("^RPL", genes, v=T), 
                grep("^RPS",genes,v=T))
cell.cycle <- c(cc.genes$s.genes, cc.genes$g2m.genes)
other <- c(grep("^MTMR", genes, v=T), grep("^MTND", genes, v=T),"NEAT1","TMSB4X", "TMSB10")
bad_genes = unique(c(ig_genes, tcr_genes, mito, ribo, cell.cycle, other))
features.remove <- list(ig_genes, tcr_genes, mito, ribo, cell.cycle, other)
rm(ig_genes, tcr_genes, mito, ribo, cell.cycle, other)

######################### START ######################
asdf.agg <- AggregateExpression(asdf, return.seurat = T, group.by = c("orig.ident", "celltype.malig"))
malig.agg <- subset(asdf.agg, celltype.malig == "Malignant")
mat.malig.agg <- malig.agg@assays$RNA@layers$data
malig.agg <- FindVariableFeatures(malig.agg, nfeatures = 4000)
features <- VariableFeatures(malig.agg)
features <- setdiff(features, c(features.remove[[1]],features.remove[[2]],features.remove[[3]],features.remove[[4]],features.remove[[5]],features.remove[[6]]))

colnames(mat.malig.agg) <- colnames(malig.agg)
rownames(mat.malig.agg) <- rownames(malig.agg)

df.rowsums <- as.data.frame(rowSums(mat.malig.agg))
df.rowsums$gene <- rownames(df.rowsums)


mat.malig.agg <- mat.malig.agg[rowSums(mat.malig.agg) >20,]
mat.malig.agg <- mat.malig.agg[rownames(mat.malig.agg) %in% features,]
#mat.malig.agg.scale <- mat.malig.agg
mat.malig.agg.scale <- ScaleData(mat.malig.agg, center = F)
range(mat.malig.agg.scale)
mat.malig.agg.scale <- mat.malig.agg.scale - min(mat.malig.agg.scale)
range(mat.malig.agg.scale)
range(mat.malig.agg)


#out <- nmf(x = mat.malig.agg, rank = c(4:6))
out.scale <- nmf(x = mat.malig.agg.scale, rank = 6)

out.w.scale <- out.scale@fit@W
out.h.scale <- out.scale@fit@H
pheatmap(out.h.scale, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)

labels <- unique(malig.agg$orig.ident)
inventory <- readxl::read_xlsx("inventory.updated.xlsx")
annotation_col = data.frame(
                    Dx =inventory$Dx, Stage = inventory$Path.Stage, Tissue = inventory$Tissue, Lesion = inventory$Sample.Type)
rownames(annotation_col) <- paste0(inventory$Sample, "_Malignant")
annotation_col$stage.bin <- ifelse(annotation_col$Stage %in% c("IA","IB","IIA"), "early", "late")


annotation_col <- annotation_col[rownames(annotation_col) %in% labels, , drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(out.h, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
pheatmap(out.h.scale, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
pheatmap(out.h, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col)
pheatmap(out.h.scale, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col)

skin <- unique(asdf$orig.ident[asdf$Tissue == "skin"])
skin <- paste0(skin, "_Malignant")



skin.mat <- subset(out.h[,colnames(out.h) %in% skin])
annotation_col.skin <- annotation_col[rownames(annotation_col) %in% skin, , drop = FALSE]
png("tmp.png", height = 1000, width = 2000)
pheatmap(skin.mat, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col.skin)
dev.off()


skin.mat.scale <- subset(out.h.scale[,colnames(out.h.scale) %in% skin])
annotation_col.skin <- annotation_col[rownames(annotation_col) %in% skin, , drop = FALSE]
png("tmp.png", height = 1000, width = 2000)
pheatmap(skin.mat.scale, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col.skin)
dev.off()

pheatmap(out[["consensus"]][["4"]], annotation_col = annotation_col)
pheatmap(out[["consensus"]][["5"]], annotation_col = annotation_col)
pheatmap(out[["consensus"]][["6"]], annotation_col = annotation_col)

h4 <- out[["fit"]][["4"]]@fit@H
h5 <- out[["fit"]][["5"]]@fit@H
h6 <- out[["fit"]][["6"]]@fit@H
w4 <- out[["fit"]][["4"]]@fit@W
w5 <- out[["fit"]][["5"]]@fit@W
w6 <- out[["fit"]][["6"]]@fit@W
h.all <- rbind(h4,h5,h6)
pheatmap(h.all, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col)

png(filename = "tmp.png", height = 1000, width = 1500)
pheatmap(h.all, scale = 'column', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col)
dev.off()

w.all <- cbind(w4,w5,w6)
cor.w.all <- cor(t(w.all))
pheatmap(cor.w.all, scale = 'none', cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, show_colnames = T)

coefmap(out[["fit"]][["4"]])
consensusmap(out,annCol=annotation_col)

out <- nmf(x = mat.malig.agg, rank = c(4:6))
out <- nmf(x = mat.malig.agg, rank = 3, nrun = 10)
out <- nmf(x = mat.malig.agg, rank = 3, method = c(list('lee', 'brunet', 'nsNMF')))

png("tmp.png", height = 1000, width = 1500)
consensusmap(out,annCol=annotation_col)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
colnames(mat.malig.agg.scale) <- str_extract(colnames(mat.malig.agg.scale), "^[^_]+")

# Find columns that are missing in each matrix

# Add missing columns filled with zeros or NA

scale_matrix <- function(mat) {
  min_val <- min(mat)  # Find the minimum value
  max_val <- max(mat)  # Find the maximum value

}
```

```{r}
combine_matrices <- function(mat1, mat2) {
  # Get all unique column names
  all_colnames <- union(colnames(mat1), colnames(mat2))
  
  # Ensure we only select columns that exist in each matrix
  mat1_aligned <- mat1[, colnames(mat1) %in% all_colnames, drop = FALSE]
  mat2_aligned <- mat2[, colnames(mat2) %in% all_colnames, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Add missing columns to each matrix with NAs
  mat1_missing_cols <- setdiff(all_colnames, colnames(mat1_aligned))
  mat2_missing_cols <- setdiff(all_colnames, colnames(mat2_aligned))
  
  # Bind NA columns for the missing ones
  if (length(mat1_missing_cols) > 0) {
    mat1_aligned <- cbind(mat1_aligned, matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(mat1), ncol = length(mat1_missing_cols),
                                               dimnames = list(NULL, mat1_missing_cols)))
  }
  if (length(mat2_missing_cols) > 0) {
    mat2_aligned <- cbind(mat2_aligned, matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(mat2), ncol = length(mat2_missing_cols),
                                               dimnames = list(NULL, mat2_missing_cols)))
  }
  
  # Reorder columns based on all_colnames
  mat1_aligned <- mat1_aligned[, all_colnames, drop = FALSE]
  mat2_aligned <- mat2_aligned[, all_colnames, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Combine by rows
  combined_mat <- rbind(mat1_aligned, mat2_aligned)
  
  return(combined_mat)
}
scale_matrix <- function(mat) {
  min_val <- min(mat)  # Find the minimum value
  max_val <- max(mat)  # Find the maximum value
  scaled_mat <- (mat - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)  # Apply the scaling formula
  return(scaled_mat)
}
mat.fibro.agg.scale <- scale_matrix(mat.fibro.agg.scale)
mat.malig.agg.scale <- scale_matrix(mat.malig.agg.scale)
combine.all <- combine_matrices(mat.fibro.agg.scale, mat.malig.agg.scale)
```

```{r}
combine_matrices_list <- function(matrices_list) {
  
  # Step 1: Get all unique column names from all matrices
  all_colnames <- Reduce(union, lapply(matrices_list, colnames))
  
  # Step 2: Align each matrix to the full set of column names, filling missing columns with NA
  aligned_matrices <- lapply(matrices_list, function(mat) {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(all_colnames, colnames(mat))
    
    # Add missing columns filled with NAs
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      mat <- cbind(mat, matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = length(missing_cols),
                               dimnames = list(NULL, missing_cols)))
    }
    
    # Reorder columns to match all_colnames
    mat <- mat[, all_colnames, drop = FALSE]
    return(mat)
  })
  
  # Step 3: Combine all aligned matrices by row
  combined_matrix <- do.call(rbind, aligned_matrices)
  
  return(combined_matrix)
}

scale_matrix <- function(mat) {
  min_val <- min(mat)  # Find the minimum value
  max_val <- max(mat)  # Find the maximum value
  scaled_mat <- (mat - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)  # Apply the scaling formula
  return(scaled_mat)
}

  colnames(mat.ss.agg) <- colnames(ss.agg)

  mat.ss.agg <- mat.ss.agg[rowSums(mat.ss.agg) >20,]
```

```{r}
  #mat.ss.agg.scale <- ScaleData(mat.ss.agg, do.center = F)
  mat.ss.agg.scale <- mat.ss.agg
                                
  rownames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- paste0(tmp, "_", rownames(mat.ss.agg.scale))

  colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- str_extract(colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale), "^[^_]+")
  colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- str_extract(colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale), "^[^_]+")
```

## MOFA MOFAcellulaR
```{r}
remotes::install_github("saezlab/MOFAcellulaR")
library(MOFAcellulaR)
vignette("MOFAcellulaR")


  

ss <- subset(asdf, orig.ident %in% rownames(df.ss))
table(ss$orig.ident)
ss@meta.data$orig.ident <- as.character(ss@meta.data$orig.ident)
ss@meta.data$celltype.malig <- as.character(ss@meta.data$celltype.malig)


ss.agg <- AggregateExpression(object = asdf, group.by = c("orig.ident", "celltype.malig"), return.seurat = T)

testcoldata <- asdf@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.ident, celltype.malig) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop')
colnames(testcoldata) <- c("donor_id", "cell_type", "cell_counts")

rownames(ss.agg@assays$RNA@layers$data) <- rownames(ss.agg)
pb_obj <- MOFAcellulaR::create_init_exp(counts = ss.agg@assays$RNA@layers$data,  coldata = testcoldata)

ct_list <- MOFAcellulaR::filt_profiles(pb_dat = pb_obj,
                          cts = c(unique(testcoldata$cell_type)),
                          ncells = 10, # Change to your knowledge!! 
                          counts_col = "cell_counts", # This refers to the column name in testcoldata where the number of cells per profile was stored
                          ct_col = "cell_type") # This refers to the column name in testcoldata where the cell-type label was stored




ct_list <- MOFAcellulaR::filt_views_bysamples(pb_dat_list = ct_list, nsamples = 10)
ct_list <- MOFAcellulaR::filt_gex_byexpr(pb_dat_list = ct_list, min.count = .1, min.prop = .1)
ct_list <- filt_views_bygenes(pb_dat_list = ct_list, ngenes = 20)
#ct_list <- filt_samples_bycov(pb_dat_list = ct_list, prop_coverage = 0.9)
ct_list <- MOFAcellulaR::tmm_trns(pb_dat_list = ct_list,
                                  scale_factor = 1000000)
names(assays(ct_list[[1]]))
multiview_dat <- pb_dat2MOFA(pb_dat_list = ct_list, 
                             sample_column = "donor_id")



MOFAobject <- MOFA2::create_mofa(multiview_dat)

data_opts <- MOFA2::get_default_data_options(MOFAobject)
train_opts <- MOFA2::get_default_training_options(MOFAobject)
model_opts <- MOFA2::get_default_model_options(MOFAobject)

# This avoids the regularization of multicellular programs per cell type.
# This avoids less sparse gene weights
model_opts$spikeslab_weights <- FALSE 

# Define the number of factors needed
model_opts$num_factors <- 5

# Prepare MOFA model:
MOFAobject.all <- MOFA2::prepare_mofa(object = MOFAobject,
                           data_options = data_opts,
                           model_options = model_opts,
                           training_options = train_opts)
  
outfile <- file.path("")

model.all <- MOFA2::run_mofa(MOFAobject.all, outfile, use_basilisk = T)


metadata <- asdf@meta.data
metadata <- metadata[, c("orig.ident","Tissue","Dx", "Path.Stage", "Sample.Type")]
metadata <- metadata %>%
  group_by(orig.ident, Tissue, Dx,Path.Stage, Sample.Type) %>% summarise()
#metadata$fake_var <- stats::rnorm(nrow(metadata))
metadata$Path.Stage <- ifelse(metadata$Path.Stage %in% c("IA", "IB"), 1,
                              ifelse(metadata$Path.Stage %in% c("IIA", "IIB"), 2,
                                     ifelse(metadata$Path.Stage %in% c("IIIA", "IIIB"), 3,
                                            ifelse(metadata$Path.Stage %in% c("IVA", "IVB"), 4, 0))))

all_factors <- MOFAcellulaR::get_tidy_factors(model = model.all,
                                 metadata = metadata,
                                 factor = "all",
                                 sample_id_column = "orig.ident")

Factor4 <- MOFAcellulaR::get_tidy_factors(model = model.all,
                             metadata = metadata,
                             factor = "Factor4",
                             sample_id_column = "orig.ident")

plot(Factor4$Path.Stage, Factor4$value)

UMAP_embedding <- MOFAcellulaR::plot_sample_2D(model = model.all,
                                               method = "UMAP",
                                               metadata = metadata,
                                               sample_id_column = "orig.ident",
                                               color_by = "Tissue")
UMAP_embedding <- MOFAcellulaR::plot_sample_2D(model = model.all,
                                               method = "UMAP",
                                               metadata = metadata,
                                               sample_id_column = "orig.ident",
                                               color_by = "Dx")
UMAP_embedding <- MOFAcellulaR::plot_sample_2D(model = model.all,
                                               method = "UMAP",
                                               metadata = metadata,
                                               sample_id_column = "orig.ident",
                                               color_by = "Path.Stage")
UMAP_embedding <- MOFAcellulaR::plot_sample_2D(model = model.all,
                                               method = "UMAP",
                                               metadata = metadata,
                                               sample_id_column = "orig.ident",
                                               color_by = "Sample.Type")

gene_weights <- MOFAcellulaR::get_geneweights(model = model.all, factor = "Factor4")
head(gene_weights)

assoc_list <- list("categorical" = categorical_assoc, "continuous" = continuous_assoc)

continuous_assoc <- MOFAcellulaR::get_associations(model = model.all,

assoc_list <- list("categorical" = categorical_assoc, "continuous" = continuous_assoc)
plot_MOFA_hmap(model = model.all,
                group = FALSE,
```
